messages:
morgan: quick ping 12:3012: sketch: add a compact 'sensitivity' card to rollout modal that shows how small trigger changes affect fallback volume, latency p95, and tokens. want a quick gut-check.
ellen: short ask: should it include decay window options (5m/15m/1h)? spikes behave very differently.
bryan: yes. show multiple decay lines. also include a tiny table of top affected routes and regions.
telemetry-bot: note: to support this we need (route, ts, trace_id, matched_signals, latency_ms, error_code). we can sample 5k requests for preview.
auditor: must persist simulation seed and policy_hash in audit events. also record who ran simulate and whether plaintext prompts were revealed.
keiko: UX: when you hover a point on the curve show a micro-audit card with rule, matched signal, and a link to jump to trace. clicking trace should open replay (redacted) with an audit checkpoint.
morgan: edge-case: probabilistic fallbacks (e.g., random 10% drain) 12:3112 display expected mean+conf interval. show distribution histogram in a mini popover.
bryan: API debate: reuse /policies/simulate or create /rollouts/simulate? prefer reuse but return a UI viewmodel: {threshold, est_fallback_rate, token_delta, sample_ids}.
ellen: also add 'what-if' slider that updates numbers live and can snapshot the simulation as an exportable artifact. artifact must be immutable and include reason.
auditor: export flow must create an audit-record with {artifact_id, who, reason, seed, dataset_window}. downloads should be time-limited signed URLs.
telemetry-bot: implementation constraint: full replay expensive -> do async job POST /simulations -> {job_id, preview}. preview = lightweight estimates and sample traces. poll /simulations/{job_id}/results for full.
keiko: accessibility note: textual summary required for screen readers: 'estimated fallback 3.6%, affects 2 routes, expected token saving 8k'.
morgan: ok next steps: i'll mock the card in figma, bryan proto the API shape, telemetry-bot will draft the sample schema, and auditor will write the export audit spec. sync tomorrow 10:00. thanks.
